_note: Copy to config.json and edit. Every key is optional; anything left out uses the default shown here. config.json is personal and never committed.
_owner_note: How you appear in transcripts (the mic track). Default: your macOS full name.
_workspace_note: Where recordings, Customers/<slug>/meetings and DB/ live.
_db_note: Default is <workspace>/DB/mt.db, created by `mt init`. Point at your own SQLite file only if it meets schema.sql (`mt doctor` checks; see docs/DATABASE.md).
_google_note: The work Google account added to macOS Calendar. Used to recognise your work calendar.
_customer_hints_note: Customers/<folder> -> fragments of meeting titles that mean that customer. Pre-selects the customer when you record from `mt web`.
_accounts_note: Per customer slug, all optional: code = item-title prefix (ACM - ...), label = short name in lists, display = name in a weekly update's Slack title, aliases = words that mean this account at the start of a description, file_aliases = old filename slugs for it.
_affiliations_note: Company names that may appear where a person's name is expected (owner fields), so they are not mistaken for people.
_jira_note: Only for posting weekly updates to Jira. Leave out to turn Jira posting off. The API token goes in ~/.config/mt/credentials.json or the keychain service named by jira_keychain (default mt-jira-api).
_assistant_note: What your AI assistant is called where mt records who did something (who posted a weekly update, who proposed a memory change).
_policy_note: Link for the 'Recording? Understand your company's recording policy.' line under the Record button. Empty = the sentence shows without a link.
_memory_note: Off by default. A folder of your AI assistant's memory files for the Hygiene -> Memory page and search. "claude" = Claude Code's memory folder for your workspace.
_mic_note: Ordered mic name fragments; the first one plugged in wins. `mt devices` lists them.
_prompt_note: Vocabulary hint for whisper: product names, people, acronyms you say a lot.
